data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 1.8 million, primarily driven by favorable claims development on underwriting years 2011, 2012, and 2013. The 2013 year of account closed with a net profit, despite absorbing losses from Hurricanes Manuel and Ingrid, Central European flooding, a diamond theft, and a cash in transit loss. The 2014 year of account also absorbed losses from Hurricane Odile and two notable risk losses on the Energy account.
